character.lede: A tall narrow cottage of stucco, grey siding and painted brick stands on the lake, its main floor up an exterior stair. A steel-stair side deck and a loft in the gable catch the light.

spots.line: A daybed, a writing desk and a sofa fill the loft in the gable.
A crib, a glider and a toy box fill the nursery.
A kitchen island sits at the centre of the upstairs kitchen.

facts.style: Tall narrow steep-gable lake-side townhouse-cottage: stucco, greige lap siding and a painted-brick strip under black trim, a garden floor beneath a raised front terrace, the main floor up an exterior stair, a steel-stair side deck, a loft in the gable

character.truths: The Core sits on a shelf in the upstairs Kitchen. A television stands in the garden-floor family room. The main floor is up an exterior stair. Pool and decks outside.

kitchenowl: [note] Learns from your list habits per its manifest.
nextcloud: [note] The Hub onboarding wizard offers Nextcloud as a recommended app.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
immich: [note] Bundles its own database and a machine-learning service, so first start takes a while.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
tandoor: [note] Overlaps Mealie; pick one per story.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
mealie: [note] Pasting a recipe URL fetches that web page. Everything it saves stays on your Core.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
pasting a URL fetches that web page
super-productivity: by default tasks live in the browser local storage, not on the Core
no sync means no custody on the Core
paperless: [note] AI features are off by default. If you turn them on they can use a local model.
[note] Office document conversion is not wired up in this build; OCR and archiving of PDFs and scans works.
radicale: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
no QA screenshot (the app has a bare web page)
sync away from home is not claimed
teampass: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Listing claims secrets never leave the appliance (banned word, banned claim)
Per-person roles sit close to the cap-multi-user rule: phrase it as the app's folders and permissions
wallos: [note] Fetches logos for popular services from outside.
jellyfin: [note] Plays your own files. Say that, not "Netflix".
[claims] Do not say it plays copyrighted material from anywhere.
Plays your own media only: never "streams any movie".
QA capture is the setup wizard with a container id as the server name; the gallery frame is a demo library with lurid exploitation film posters: neither usable.
navidrome: Description says "from anywhere" and "works offline-first": paraphrase, remote access is not claimed
Already in 11 of 30 stories: one short of the cap of 12; rotate music beats to mStream, Swing Music and Music Assistant
home-assistant: [hardware] The Hub package runs without privileged host mounts. Integrations that need direct USB, Bluetooth or D-Bus access (a Zigbee stick, for example) are not enabled by default.
[note] Ships with a Matter server container alongside. Its manifest sets host_access true because that container uses host networking; no USB, Bluetooth or D-Bus access is granted.
[claims] Do not promise energy savings. Home Assistant has no energy figures in the listing.
Matter container uses host networking (host_access true); no USB, Bluetooth or D-Bus access is granted, so no Zigbee stick.
The QA capture is the onboarding page (shows the product, no data).
hortusfox: Do not say it keeps plants alive
Plant health alerts and a public gallery exist: keep the gallery off in a story
joplin: [note] Joplin Server only; the Joplin apps are separate.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
marketplace: Joplin Server carries its own Personal Use License: not open source and limited for business use.
donetick: [cloud-link] Notifications use Telegram or Pushover. Both are outside services.
NFC-tag completion needs a phone that reads NFC on the home network
kokoro: [note] OpenAI-compatible speech API. No GPU requirement in the listing.
OpenAI-compatible speech API; web player included.
No GPU requirement in the listing; no speed claim.
Capture is real (FastKoko player) on a dark purple background.
homebox: [note] Barcode and Open Food Facts lookups call outside services.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Analytics are switched off in the manifest (good)
changedetection: The UI shows a "Let us host your instance!" banner linking to the vendor's hosted service
Does not hide the Core from the sites it watches
monetr: marketplace: Replaces lists Mint, which Intuit retired in 2024.
marketplace: Licence is the Functional Source License (not open source).
adguardhome: [note] Overlaps Pi-hole; pick one per story.
[claims] Same as Pi-hole: no parental-control promise.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Listing mentions adult-content parental controls: never repeat it (sec-safety-people)
hermitstash: Listing claims post-quantum encryption and that every field is encrypted: do not repeat (sec-absolute)
Public Drop page lets visitors upload without an account
searxng: [cloud-link] It queries outside search engines for you. Say "private search", not "offline search".
cloud-link: the engines still see the query from the Core
listing says users are not tracked: do not repeat
miniflux: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Integrations push to outside services if switched on (Pocket, Telegram, webhooks)
